w_quantized * (w_max - w_min)\n    \n    return w_quantized\n\ndef apply_sparsity(w, sparsity_percent):\n    \"\"\"\n    Zero out the smallest magnitude weights.\n    sparsity_percent: percentage of indices_sorted_by_magnitude = np.argsort(np.abs(w_copy))\n    indices_to_zero = indices_sorted_by_magnitude[:k]\n    w_copy[indices_to_zero] = 0\n    \n    return w_copy\n\n# Test compression
